_what: The runs this GPU session performs. The notebook reads this file from the repository checkout, so the experiment is defined in version control rather than in a notebook copy.
_rule: To change what runs: edit this file, commit, push. The notebook needs no changes.
purpose: Session Y3: plan ru_probe on the YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B pair, one model per card — the four Russian pre-cutoff files of AMENDMENT_1 with rows under 200 tokens (hflabs_city, govdomains, mos_zemelnye_uchastki, mos_torgovye_obekty), the fresh control trudvsem_vacancies_2026, and iris as the in-session anchor; header and row completion, the same cells the Nemo pair ran in session C1. It tests prediction 3 of AMENDMENT_9 and H2 proper on a model trained from scratch on Russian: after Y1 and Y2 this pair holds МКБ-10 as ordered text and names ОКВЭД 2 codes (reports/RESULTS_EXPOSURE.md Parts IV-V), where the Nemo pair was negative on every one of these files. iris must return 76/142 and 53/142 as in Y1 and Y2. russian_retail (ru_probe_long) runs in the next session together with the Nemo pair's C2, so that four models meet that file in one session.
attached_input: trudvsem_vacancies_2026.csv — the frozen fresh control, attached as a Kaggle dataset as in session C1; it cannot be re-fetched. The other four Russian files are fetched from their registered sources and hash-checked before any weights load

requires.note: verified against the checkout before any weights are downloaded

runs.why: the pretrain model; 6.1 h by src/price_plan.py with its own tokenizer, which priced the three earlier plans of this model within 10%; the Nemo pair's C1 of the same plan scaled by this model's speed on exposure_1 gives 5.8 h
its instruct model, same cells, same seed, the other card. Needs the T4 x2 accelerator
